page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m2.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.u0 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores, indicating a configuration with 1.0 thread per core and no hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 24.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a predictable compute-centric profile without the overhead of hyperthreading, positioning it as a resource-dense option for workloads requiring dedicated execution threads.

Given the 12 dedicated physical cores and 24.0 GB of RAM, the ecs.u0.c1m2.3xlarge is suited for compute-bound tasks that benefit from dedicated core execution and do not require local NVMe storage or high memory-to-CPU ratios. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, microservices, and lightweight containerized applications.
